about: Prompt cards for 'Need ideas?' and Poker Face provocations. Plain text only; nothing here claims to detect anything.
ideas: I once met someone famous in a lift.
I have never broken a bone.
I can touch my nose with my tongue.
I have been on television.
I cried at the end of a cartoon this year.
I have eaten the same breakfast every day for a month.
I once got lost in my own neighbourhood.
I have a scar from a cooking accident.
I speak three languages.
I have slept through an earthquake.
I have never seen a single episode of a famous sitcom everyone quotes.
I have won a prize in a raffle.
I was once locked out on a balcony for two hours.
I know all the words to a song in a language I don't speak.
I have been stung by a jellyfish.
I once returned a library book twelve years late.
I can juggle three balls.
I have never dyed my hair.
I once sent a message to the wrong group chat and left the chat.
I have milked a cow.
I have a secret talent nobody here has seen.
I have climbed a mountain over 3,000 metres.
I have never been on a rollercoaster.
I once ate twelve tacos in one sitting.
I have met my doppelgänger.
I was once in a music video.
I have a tattoo nobody here knows about.
I have never lost my keys.
I once talked my way backstage at a concert.
I can name every capital city in Europe.

lines: Your left sock is on inside out.
Somebody in this room is thinking about your ears right now.
Do not think of a penguin in a top hat.
Say 'toy boat' five times fast. In your head. Faster.
A seagull has just stolen a whole sandwich. Whole.
The person who taught you to whistle is very proud of you.
Imagine a cat trying to open a door with a credit card.
This sentence has a typo in it. Find it.
Your nose is itching. Isn't it. Just a little.
Remember that thing you said in 2019? Yeah.
A duck walks into a bar. The bartender says: 'Again?'
Somewhere, a goat is screaming like a person.
You blinked. That's fine. Nobody noticed.
Picture your boss in a bath full of jelly.
There is a tiny chef in a pan somewhere waving at you.
Keep it together. The dog is watching.
Hold still. A butterfly has landed on your eyebrow.
Your phone just took a photo. (It didn't.)
Don't smile. Don't smile. Don't smile. Don't—
You are doing great. Suspiciously great.
